headline: Anthropic announces official voting information and election results for Claude ahead of US midterms
summary: On October 14, 2026, Anthropic described updated US-midterm election safeguards and announced planned additions to Claude: state-specific voting information from Democracy Works later in October, and official election results on election night and in the following days. Anthropic also reports an analysis of about 250,000 US Claude.ai consumer conversations from one week in September; the company says election or voting questions were about 0.51% of conversations, requests for voting recommendations about 0.01%, and activity violating its election-integrity policies about 0.002%. These are provider-reported findings and future product plans, not independently audited results or verified rollout.
